title: Builder-family detection and diff-aware review posting
summary: This change makes two parts of the review pipeline stricter and more precise. Builder-family detection now reads every word of a `Code-Generator:` trailer (vendor names and model ids alike) instead of only the first word, reports why a family is unknown, and fails the run closed when any commit in the range lacks a usable trailer — except a clean merge, which `git merge-tree --write-tree` proves introduces nothing of its own. Separately, review posting now fetches the pull request's diff and only emits inline comments on lines the diff actually shows; findings outside it move into the review body, which is trimmed and counted so the review still posts.
